response.sql: WITH project_counts AS (SELECT arcref, COUNT(*) as count FROM scanqc GROUP BY arcref), totals AS (SELECT SUM(count) as total_count, COUNT(*) as num_projects FROM project_counts) SELECT pc.arcref, pc.count, 1.0 * pc.count / t.total_count as share, 1.0 * pc.count / t.total_count - 1.0 / t.num_projects as deviation FROM project_counts pc CROSS JOIN totals t ORDER BY deviation DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
